patterns.name: supported_low_amplitude_typing
patterns.tested_result: Provisional usable 4s; smaller alternating fingers and mostly static camera. Facial softening and regular cadence remain.
patterns.guidance: Establish low wrists and actual key contact in the still; request individual brief key presses without a performative completion gesture.

patterns.name: continuous_trackpad_glide
patterns.tested_result: Rejected: hand crosses onto keys then withdraws. Correct starting contact did not persist.
patterns.guidance: Do not infer reliable trackpad operation from starting pose. Review every movement phase.

patterns.name: single_trackpad_tap
patterns.tested_result: Only 0–1.25s retained. Later lifted curled pose persists even after reducing action to a tap.
patterns.guidance: Reducing action is a revision hypothesis, not a guaranteed correction. Preserve rejected tails in experimental comparisons.

patterns.name: typing_then_read_pause
patterns.tested_result: Reject full take: pronounced curled-hand pose after about 1.7s. Only 0–1.5s side typing retained.
patterns.guidance: A transition to reading can trigger a hand performance; never accept based on face alone.

limitations: No matched baseline; changed models and source images confound comparisons.
Behavioral reference cues in prompts, not direct motion-video conditioning.
No external mouse, speech, UI accuracy or cross-shot identity assessment.
